advancements.guhs.verhalen.guhrio_getemd: Guhshi is yours (one time only, just for you)
gui.guhs.verhaal.kopie.guhshi: Nyeg? I'm busy with my story. Come back in a bit!
gui.guhs.kledingbron.guhrio_beloning: Super Guhrio (Toad-guh's Stall and the tower room)
gui.guhs.spelgroep.guhrio_beloning.waar: In the frying sauce sea of the Guhbarbecuether: Big Nether Mika's Castle, with Toad-guh on the forecourt. Nyeg!
block.guhs.guhriobeloning_vraagblok.lore: Bonk it with your head (or click): one cheese nibble per player every day. Nom-nyeg!
block.guhs.guhriobeloning_vlaggenmast.lo: Stack them into a pole: the base goes at the bottom, the little flag on top. Click for a party.
block.guhs.guhriobeloning_pijp.lore: Stand on it and sneak: you pop out at the nearest pipe of the same color, up to 50 blocks away. Use dye to make a different pair.
block.guhs.guhriobeloning_scorebord.lore: Shows the fastest times of Super Guhrio. Click for your own times.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.prijs.kroon: from Princess Peachguh, after the duel
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.intro.1: Nyeg! A hero! I'm Toad-guh. Big Nether Mika has carried off Princess Peachguh. 'For a piece of cake', he said. A PIECE? It was the whole cake, chonk!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.intro.2: Through the gate you reach the level hall: six levels, seen from the side. Nobody hurts you, Mikas only shove. Whoever falls is right back at their flag.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.intro.3: The coins from the levels you spend with me: outfits and building blocks. And look for the three big chonk coins in every level. For all eighteen I've got something very shiny, wahoog!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.hallo: Nyeg, there you are again! You have %s coins in your pouch. What do you fancy?
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.gag: Thank you! But the princess is in another part of the castle, nyeg. (Nicely done though: %s cleared from start to finish. Wahoog!)
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.na_duel: You found the princess! And, was she just sitting there eating cake? Thought so, nyeg. Thanks for everything, hero. The stall stays open!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.gouden_: EIGHTEEN big chonk coins! Super wahoog! Here it is then: the Golden Chonk Cap. Only for the very greatest collectors, nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.outfits: Outfits! Fresh from the mushroom. You have %s coins. What will it be?
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.blokken: Building blocks, for at home. Straight from the castle! You have %s coins. What will it be?
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.gekocht: Here you go: %s! Have fun with it, nyeg. You have %s coins left.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.tekort: Nyeg... you're %s coins short (you have %s). Go grab some more in the levels: you get a tip at every flagpole too!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.padguh.vadsmun: Your big chonk coins. 1-1: %s  1-2: %s  2-1: %s  2-2: %s  3-1: %s  3-2: %s. That makes %s of the 18, chonk!
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.waar.schild: Shell for on the back (40 coins)
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.fooi: Toad-guh slips you a tip of %s coins. You now have %s in your pouch, nyeg!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.wacht: Shh! Don't tell anyone: I haven't been kidnapped at all. The cake here is just really yummy, nyeg. But Big Nether Mika does so love playing knight... Clear all the levels first!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.bijna: All levels cleared, well done! Now just the duel. He only shoves, you know. After that I have something pretty for you, nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.dank.1: My hero! You won the duel. Big Nether Mika is sulking in the sauce now. It'll pass: he's simply getting cake in a minute.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.dank.2: Here, my little crown. For your guh, as a thank-you. And take a cake with you. He was just peckish, you see? Nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.dank.3: And look who wants to come with you! Guhshi has been wagging his tail this whole time. Go on, click him: he's yours. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.dank.3_: And you already have Guhshi with you, I see. Take good care of him: he'll snap up nibbles from very far away. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.kroon_k: Lost your little crown? Nyeg, heroes... Here's a new one. Put it on right away this time!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.dag: Hello hero! Guhshi is still waiting for you over there. Go on, click him, nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.perzik.dag_guh: Hello hero! How is Guhshi doing? Toss him a nibble from me: that's his favorite thing, nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.guhshi.vraag: Guhshi looks at you and wags his tail. Nyeg? May he come with you?
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.guhshi.wacht: Guhshi gives you a sniff. He only goes along with whoever has won the duel with Big Nether Mika, nyeg.
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.guhshi.wacht_e: Guhshi remembers you from his egg! Win the duel with Big Nether Mika and he'll come with you. Nyeg nyeg!
quest.guhs.guhriobeloning.guhshi.al_gete: Nom-nyeg! This Guhshi stays with the princess. You already have yours.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.guhshi.vrij: Guhshi wants to come with you! He's waiting with Princess Peachguh in the tower room: click him.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.guhshi.gelukt: Guhshi is yours! He's already wearing his saddle: hop on, jump, and hold space to flutter. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.guhshi.tong.aan: %s is snapping up nibbles off the ground again, nom!
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.vraagblok.knabbe: Ploink! A cheese nibble from the question block. Another one tomorrow, nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.vraagblok.morgen: Tonk. Empty for today: there'll be a nibble in it again tomorrow, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.pijp.hint: Stand on the pipe and sneak (Shift): you pop out at the nearest pipe of the same color.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.pijp.geen_partne: This pipe doesn't come out anywhere. Place another pipe of the same color within %s blocks, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.pijp.afstappen: Hop off first: your guh doesn't fit in the pipe, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.pijp.bezig: Not right now: you're in the middle of something, nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhriobeloning.pijp.geverfd: The whole pipe has a fresh new color. Pipes of the same color belong together.

gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio_beloning.uitleg: What Super Guhrio leaves you with: Guhshi, outfits, building blocks and eighteen big chonk coins. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio_beloning.nu.0: Talk to Toad-guh. He sits on the counter of his mushroom stall, on the left of the castle forecourt.
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio_beloning.waar.0: Toad-guh's Stall on the forecourt of Big Nether Mika's Castle (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.verhalen.guhrio_beloning.nu.1: Win the duel with Big Nether Mika. In the tower room behind it, Guhshi is waiting with Princess Peachguh: click him and say yes.
